wholePhysicalScope: The named native multipolygon fixes the tall prayer hall and paved forecourt. The mapped inner open area and orthogonal dimensions guide the arcade spacing. The independently recorded point of the central tomb and historic survey relationships locate the selected mausolea.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the central dome, four half-domes and two double-balconied minarets, portico, fountain and adjacent imperial tombs.
limitations: The measured dome span (municipal 18.42 m, structural report rounds to 19 m), 37 m dome crown and 41.1 m twin minarets follow the Turkish measured building study. Other catalogs give different minaret figures. Slope and floor reference are approximate.

The main shell is adapted to the mapped perimeter. Arcades, exact dome shoulders, lead seam rhythms, minaret terracotta ornaments and carved stone opening details are estimates from visual and written evidence.

Three mausolea are modeled near the independently indexed Şehzade Mehmed monument. Exact adjacent outlines and footing heights are documented estimates. Remaining tombs, madrasa, hospice and caravanserai stay outside the reconstruction.
